excerpt: "The beamline from the LANSCE switchyard to the FPNS target is composed of existing Switchyard - Line A beamline and additional beamline, which is supposed to be constructed in Area A ... The FPNS target will be located near the center of Area A, some 100 m downstream of the end of the 800-MeV accelerator."
publisher: Elsevier (Nuclear Instruments and Methods in Physics Research A)
title: Batygin and Pitcher, "Advancement of LANSCE Accelerator Facility as a 1-MW Fusion Prototypic Neutron Source"
